title: Service Contracts: commitment bands and contract term by tier
content:
## Scope
This quick reference belongs to the Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts product. For each of the six contract tiers it states the band of minimum quantity commitment (MQC) the tier covers and the shortest and longest contract term the tier may run.

## Parameters by tier
The commitment is a whole number of forty-foot equivalent units (FEU) for the whole contract term; the term is counted in calendar months.

| Tier | Lowest MQC (FEU per term) | Highest MQC (FEU per term) | Shortest term (months) | Longest term (months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Starter Service Contract | 25 | 99 | 6 | 12 |
| AHL Standard Service Contract | 100 | 299 | 12 | 12 |
| AHL Regional Account Contract | 300 | 799 | 12 | 12 |
| AHL Key Account Contract | 800 | 1999 | 12 | 24 |
| AHL Global Account Contract | 2000 | 4999 | 12 | 36 |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | 5000 | 25000 | 24 | 36 |

## Reading the table
- The bands run one after another with no gap and no overlap: each tier's lowest commitment is the next whole FEU above the preceding tier's highest commitment (99 then 100, 299 then 300, 799 then 800, 1999 then 2000, 4999 then 5000).
- The AHL Standard Service Contract and the AHL Regional Account Contract each have a single term length, because their shortest and longest terms are both 12 months.
- Only the AHL Starter Service Contract has a shortest term below 12 months; only the AHL Strategic Partner Contract has a shortest term above 12 months.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical commitments and terms)
**Which band holds a commitment of 300 FEU?** The AHL Regional Account Contract band, whose lowest figure is 300; it lies above the highest figure of the AHL Standard Service Contract band, 299.

**Which band holds a commitment of 1999 FEU?** The AHL Key Account Contract band, because 1999 is that band's highest figure.

**Which tiers allow a 24-month term?** The AHL Key Account Contract (up to 24 months), the AHL Global Account Contract (up to 36 months) and the AHL Strategic Partner Contract (from 24 months). The other three tiers stop at 12 months.

**Can an AHL Strategic Partner Contract run for 12 months?** No. Its shortest term is 24 months.
